incidents.title: January ascorbic acid stockout
incidents.narrative: Winter Vitamin C demand outran a reorder point set for summer, and Northgate's New Year truck ran ten days late. A Vitamin C batch waited two days for a rush order from Ridgeway Ascorbics with $1,180 of next-day freight.

incidents.title: Duplicate invoice paid
incidents.narrative: A Pacific Excipient invoice was keyed in twice from paper, the second time with a space and a stray full stop, and both copies were paid. The amount is recoverable.

incidents.title: Packaging freight surcharge
incidents.narrative: Packaging carriers added a fuel surcharge of $85 a delivery from May through July.

incidents.title: Holiday shutdown
incidents.narrative: The plant closes for two days at the end of December: no batches, no trucks.

priceDrift.sentence: Orchard Flavor House billed sucralose at $101.2974/kg on HP-PO-0039, up 11.2% on its $91.106289/kg trailing price (HP-PO-0008, HP-PO-0022, HP-PO-0029). It was a real, received order, so it is in the export with both prices; worth a call before the next one.

Pacific Excipient Co. billed silicon dioxide at $7.2437/kg on HP-PO-0068, up 12.4% on its $6.4418/kg trailing price (HP-PO-0009, HP-PO-0028, HP-PO-0047). It was a real, received order, so it is in the export with both prices; worth a call before the next one.
